ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Estimated 15% high-intensity (white/light-grey) to 85% low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A contiguous high-intensity white pixel cluster is located at the vertex of the median notch. Dense stochastic light-pixel mottling is localized on the distal 25% of both lateral lobes. The central and proximal regions consist of a uniform, low-intensity dark pixel field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped vertex with an internal angle of approximately 110 degrees; the depth of the depression occupies approximately 12% of the vertical height of the fluke's bounding box.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Heterogeneous serration pattern along the trailing edge with pixel-amplitude variations of 3-7 pixels; a higher frequency of irregular peaks and valleys is observed on the left lobe relative to the right.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a primarily concave trajectory from the median notch toward the distal tips; the leading edge exhibits a consistent convex curvature.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of high-contrast, circular white pixel groups (rosettes) are visible on the distal tips of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent focal depigmentation (white patch) at the median notch vertex; irregular, non-symmetrical tissue profiles at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
